sources.entry: Pydio - Turn any web server into a powerful file management system and an alternative to mainstream cloud storage providers. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Go

summary.one_liner: Pydio Cells is a self-hostable, Go-based micro-service file sharing and content collaboration platform for organizations.
summary.what_it_does: Pydio Cells is described as a full rewrite of the Pydio project in Go using a micro-service architecture. The README covers building the backend from source with make dev, configuring it with ./cells configure against a database, and starting it with ./cells start. It requires Go 1.21 or higher and a MySQL 5.6+ or MariaDB database. The project includes a test suite run with go test, and an optional live-reload workflow using air. The README also mentions pre-built binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows, and a translation effort for the web interface via Crowdin.
use_cases: self-hosted file sharing for an organization
turning a web server into a file management system
developing or contributing to Go file sharing code
notable: Full rewrite of the Pydio project in Go using micro-services
Guided installer via ./cells configure after creating a database
Pre-built binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows
Continuation of Pydio; some frontend code ported from pydio-core
caveats: README warns the Cells v5 work-in-progress branch is used at your own risk
Windows is not yet supported per the README (build notes say it might have unknown glitches)
Requires an external MySQL or MariaDB database
